scope: zero-spin instantaneous supplied-host branch fragment; design only
sign: compression-positive for sigma, D, h, c, Z; all source tensors reversed consistently

loading.input: D: six finite symmetric Mandel values per dimensionless path coordinate

host_stage_outputs: N_hyp with same-stage modified f_e and f_d
scalar_stage_order: validate full supplied state and explicit branch
current stress/e host baseline F and f_d0
F_d using baseline f_d0 and f_z using current Z,N
main beta_h using current strain-image mapping

branches.elastic: F_H<0; h_prime=D,c_prime=0,stress_prime=m_R*L_hyp(D); full Z/eps_acc require separately valid dependencies
branches.boundary: F_H=0; source lambda positive-part; unloading lambda zero does not silently change printed boundary M
branches.outside: F_H>0 unsupported; predictor overshoot needs independently defined algorithm

initialization.restarts: restore every state and variant; never reset or reinitialize on ordinary restart

required_mathematical_checks: finite real numbers; reject bool and nonfinite
unresolved_choices: Appendix39 F and Appendix40 Lode convention

transaction.evaluate: immutable input; no state changes until complete accepted result
transaction.rollback: exact original snapshot on any trial-domain,budget,event,normalization or solver failure; retain attempted coverage diagnostics
